sources.title: RedHatAI/gemma-2-9b-it-quantized.w8a16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Optimizations This model was obtained by quantizing the weights of gemma-2-9b-it to INT8 data type. This optimization reduces the number of bits per parameter from 16 to 8, reducing the disk size and GPU memory requirements by approximately 50%. Only the weights of the linear operators within transformers blocks are quantized.
